capabilities: display filtered notes on their dates in a calendar view
reschedule events via drag and drop, updating note frontmatter
configure start and optional end date properties for multi-day events
navigate between months with calendar controls
open entries by click or context menu
extras: Requires Obsidian v1.10.0 or later; installable via BRAT as a beta plugin.
intentEvidence: Adds a calendar layout to Obsidian Bases so you can display notes with dates
problem: Bases views lack a way to show date-bearing notes visually on a calendar and reschedule them by dragging.

relations.evidence: Built with FullCalendar for a robust and feature-rich calendar experience.

summary: Adds a calendar layout to Obsidian Bases that displays notes with date properties as draggable events in an interactive calendar view.
